app_type: on-device voice capture and organization app

findings.must_become_true: An exact archive exists and its bundle metadata, signing, entitlements, and privacy manifests are recorded.
findings.requirement_at_risk: A reviewable build must be archived, signed, and inspectable.
findings.title: No exact signed archive
findings.verification: Run the product archive command and inspect the exported artifact.

evidence: missing fields: subtitle, description, keywords, copyright, support_url, privacy_url
findings.must_become_true: All applicable metadata fields are populated from product truth and reviewed.
findings.requirement_at_risk: App Store Connect metadata must be complete and accurate.
findings.title: Required store metadata is missing
findings.verification: Validate the metadata draft against the App Store Connect field contract.

findings.must_become_true: Name, subtitle, keywords, category, description, developer identity, and screenshot story are reviewed for clarity, consistency, and non-stuffing.
findings.requirement_at_risk: A customer who needs the product must be able to understand and reasonably find it.
findings.title: Discoverability review is incomplete
findings.verification: Perform the current Apple metadata and customer-facing discoverability review.

findings.must_become_true: Accurate age-rating answers are recorded for the actual product content and behavior.
findings.requirement_at_risk: An unrated product cannot be App Review ready.
findings.title: Age rating is incomplete
findings.verification: Complete the current App Store Connect age-rating questionnaire and review it against product evidence.

findings.must_become_true: Current-build, device-correct, opaque screenshot candidates pass dimension and traceability checks.
findings.requirement_at_risk: Screenshots must match supported device families, dimensions, content, and build.
findings.title: Screenshot candidates are invalid or absent
findings.verification: Run the existing capture pipeline and validate its asset manifest.

findings.must_become_true: Reviewer contact, notes, setup instructions, demo credentials if applicable, and hardware requirements are complete.
findings.requirement_at_risk: Reviewers need contact information, notes, setup, and access to non-obvious functionality.
findings.title: App Review information is incomplete
findings.verification: Validate the review-information draft before submission preparation.

findings.must_become_true: Products, pricing, restore, failure, entitlement, and review metadata are configured and tested.
findings.requirement_at_risk: IAP/subscription products require valid StoreKit behavior and App Store metadata.
findings.title: Purchase configuration is incomplete
findings.verification: Run StoreKit tests and validate the App Store Connect product draft.

findings.must_become_true: Automated and applicable device assistive-technology evidence supports each declaration.
findings.requirement_at_risk: Accessibility declarations must reflect tested behavior.
findings.title: Accessibility evidence is incomplete
findings.verification: Run accessibility audits and applicable device traversal checks.

findings.must_become_true: The encryption inventory and applicable export answers are reviewed and recorded.
findings.requirement_at_risk: Encryption/export questions must be answered accurately before submission.
findings.title: Export compliance decision is missing
findings.verification: Complete the current export-compliance questionnaire and retain required documentation.

identity_review.workflow: CUSTOMER_ZERO -> PURPOSE -> CANDIDATES -> COLLISION_AND_TRADEMARK_RESEARCH -> HUMAN_SELECTION -> AUTHORIZATION -> PROPAGATION
